name: room-goal
title: Room Goal
description: One meter for the whole room: a shared target, named milestones on the way ("Bonus round", "Group photo"), and, when given, how many rounds in a row most of the room got right. Built for the shared screen; it reads the same on a phone.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/room-goal

Installed to `components/ui/games/room-goal.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/room-goal';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/room-goal

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
